title: Biblical Passage Fragments for Tim / Scripture Parallel Reading
purpose: Supply short, exact, public-domain scripture fragments to the Biblical Syncretism Field. Interpretation remains in the relation and specialist-owner records; this file never rewrites scripture.

fragments.text: Yahweh God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

Out of the ground Yahweh God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; including the tree of life in the middle of the garden, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
So he drove out the man; and he placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.
Behold, a stairway set upon the earth, and its top reached to heaven. Behold, the angels of God ascending and descending on it. … This is none other than God’s house, and this is the gate of heaven.
Judah is a lion’s cub. … The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs.
For you are a holy people to Yahweh your God. Yahweh your God has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.
Of Dan he said, ‘Dan is a lion’s cub that leaps out of Bashan.’
Then he brought me to the door of the gate of Yahweh’s house which was toward the north; and behold, there sat the women weeping for Tammuz.
A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit. Yahweh’s Spirit will rest on him.
The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.
The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.

Enter in by the narrow gate; for wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many are those who enter in by it. How narrow is the gate and restricted is the way that leads to life!
Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.
Jesus said to them, ‘I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.’

Jesus therefore said to them again, ‘Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door. … I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out, and will find pasture.’
In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.
Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.
Most certainly, I tell you, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.

fragments.text: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, ‘We have found the Messiah!’ (which is, being interpreted, Christ).

The appearance of the wheels and their work was like a beryl. … Wherever the spirit was to go, they went. The wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.
Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures, … he was buried, … he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures, and … he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.

Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome. … I saw in the middle of the throne … a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God.
I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God. … Behold, God’s dwelling is with people, and he will dwell with them.
Behold, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him a number, one hundred forty-four thousand, having his name and the name of his Father written on their foreheads.
Behold, I will bring out my servant, the Branch. For, behold, the stone that I have set before Joshua; on one stone are seven eyes.
I have seen, and behold, a lamp stand all of gold … and its seven lamps on it. … These seven are Yahweh’s eyes, which run back and forth through the whole earth.
